subject: Intro: Redwood + Orion Logistics — AWS partner intro & 90-day account alignment
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@orionlogistics.com>, Tom Brenner <tom.brenner@orionlogistics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro: Redwood + Orion Logistics — AWS partner intro & 90-day account alignment

Hi Elaine / Tom —

Thanks again for taking a few minutes on the phone earlier. As discussed, Redwood Inference would love to partner with Orion Logistics to pilot faster, lower-cost inference for your route-optimization and real-time ETA features. AWS recommended we sync up for a formal intro and to sketch a 60–90 day joint account plan that aligns engineering, procurement, and the AWS co-sell team.

Proposed agenda for a 60-minute kickoff:
- Quick intros (5m)
- Business goals & success metrics (10m)
- Current infra & constraints (10m)
- Proposed pilot scope and milestones (20m)
- Risks, procurement timeline, and next steps (15m)

I'm attaching a light 90-day plan template and our AWS co-sell checklist to help frame the discussion (see attachments).

Would next Tuesday (4/20) 10:00–11:00 PT or Wednesday (4/21) 13:00–14:00 PT work for your team? If neither, please propose two slots. Also, please add anyone from procurement/legal who should be on the kickoff.

Thanks — looking forward to building this together.

— Diego
Diego Fernandez
Head of Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
attachments: [Orion_RL_90day_plan.xlsx (spreadsheet), Redwood_AWS_co-sell_checklist.pdf (pdf)]

From: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@orionlogistics.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Brenner <tom.brenner@orionlogistics.com>, AWS Co-sell SA <aws-cosell-sa@amazon.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood + Orion Logistics — AWS partner intro & 90-day account alignment

Diego — thanks for the clear note and the template. Happy to run this with the team.

Both Tom and I are available on Tue 4/20 10–11 PT. I'll loop in our procurement lead (Lynn Park) after we confirm the slot — she's out this week but available to attend next Tuesday. A couple of quick notes up front:
- Our primary goal is reducing inference latency on the routing microservice by >30% while holding or lowering cost-per-request.
- Procurement timeline: target PO by end of June; we need a brief SOW + pricing to start legal review.
- AWS recommended the co-sell SA join the kickoff to discuss marketplace listing implications — I see them cc'd.

Tom will be on the call; I'll add Lynn as soon as she confirms availability. Confirming Tue 4/20 10:00 PT for now.

Best,
Elaine
Elaine Wu
Director of Product, Orion Logistics

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@orionlogistics.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-13T08:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood + Orion Logistics — AWS partner intro & 90-day account alignment

Thanks Elaine — great to meet you (virtually) ahead of the kickoff. Per Diego's note and Elaine's goals, we'll be prepared to cover:
- Pilot success metrics & measurement plan (Marissa)
- Sizing/instance recommendations and expected token throughput (Karthik)
- Marketplace listing options and co-sell eligibility checklist (Sean)

For the kickoff please expect:
- A one-slide MOU-level scope (draft attached: draft-MOU-Orion-Redwood.pdf)
- A proposed milestone map in the attached 90-day workbook (Orion_RL_90day_plan.xlsx)

Logistics: Tue 4/20 10:00–11:00 PT confirmed. I'll send a calendar invite with a short pre-read and a Google Drive link to the materials. Could you confirm Lynn's email for procurement so we can include the SOW placeholder in the pre-read?

On procurement: to speed review, we usually include: statement of work, data handling summary, and a draft procurement addendum for marketplace purchases. If Orion needs a Net-30 or custom terms, flag that so we can surface to finance.

Cheers,
Marissa
Director, Partnerships Enablement
attachments: [draft-MOU-Orion-Redwood.pdf (pdf), Orion_RL_90day_plan.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@orionlogistics.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, AWS Co-sell SA <aws-cosell-sa@amazon.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood + Orion Logistics — AWS partner intro & 90-day account alignment

All — thanks for locking the time. Looking forward to the kickoff tomorrow. Quick prep notes and asks: 

1) Attendees: please include one technical lead from Orion who can speak to current infra (metrics, traffic patterns) and Lynn from procurement/legal if possible.
2) Pre-read: I'll circulate a 1-page co-sell checklist and a redlines-friendly SOW template prior to the call (see attachments).
3) Marketplace and procurement: if Orion prefers a marketplace purchase, that generally shortens procurement but we need to confirm expected committed spend bands — even a rough estimate helps AWS co-sell planning.

Next steps (post-kickoff):
- Redwood to deliver updated 90-day plan & SOW draft within 5 business days
- Joint success metrics and dashboard owner assigned
- AWS co-sell SA to open the joint engagement record (cc'd)

Attachments: Redwood_AWS_co-sell_checklist.pdf, draft-MOU-Orion-Redwood.pdf

See you tomorrow 10:00 PT — invite on its way.

— Sean
Sean Gallagher
Head of Field Sales, Redwood Inference
